task.description: WF-03 Step 2: Produce a fix design for ISS-0714 / GH #809 based on the root-cause analysis in docs/issues/ISS-0714.json. The diagnosis: dev-DB-only state mismatch — tenant_default schema is already modern (partitioned events) but public.schema_migrations has 0 rows for tenant_default and tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL, so provisionTenantSchema() re-applies all migrations from scratch and 001_event_store.sql:48 (unique index on partitioned events) fails with 42P16. The fix is dev-DB-only: (1) populate public.schema_migrations for schema_name='tenant_default' with the 111 non-public-only migrations (canonical reference = test DB's tenant_default ledger), (2) UPDATE public.tenant_schemas SET migrations_applied_at=NOW() for the default tenant, (3) verify reconciled versions match objects present. Then zig build migrate fast-paths and zig build bench proceeds. Write the design to src/design/fix-ISS-0714-bench-env.md. The design must specify the exact reconciliation procedure (SQL + verification) WITHOUT executing it, and must be complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to run without ambiguity. No implementation code beyond the reconciliation script itself (that IS the fix — data repair, not app code).
